DAM-57: rollback wrong cornerstone migrations (#503)

## Summary
- revert the unintended cornerstone cloud print migrations introduced by PR #501
- remove the extra liquibase changelog include and records file for those cloud print nodes
- rename the statistics chart Flyway records migration from `V0000100` to `V00000201`

## Why
- `DAM-57` asks to roll back the wrong `endfather` migration changes
- Flyway normalizes leading zeros, so `V0000100` collided with the existing version `V00000100`
- `V00000201` is the next free `traice/cornerstone/records` version after the current history

## Validation
- `docker run --rm -v /code/symphony/0xfe10/workspaces/DAM-57/endfather/traice/cornerstone/records:/flyway/sql flyway/flyway:10-alpine -url=jdbc:h2:mem:testdb -user=sa -locations=filesystem:/flyway/sql -encoding=UTF-8 info`
- `git diff --check`

## Database Repair SQL
If a database already applied the bad cloud print records migration and/or the old statistics migration name, run the following MySQL statements before the next Flyway run:

```sql
START TRANSACTION;

DELETE FROM b_node
WHERE id IN (
  '1774486500000003072',
  '1774486500000004096',
  '1774486500000005120',
  '1774486500000006144'
);

DELETE FROM b_node
WHERE id IN (
  '1774486500000002048',
  '1774486500000001024'
);

DELETE FROM flyway_schema_history
WHERE version IN ('101', '00000101')
  AND script = 'V0000101__add_cloud_print_nodes.sql';

UPDATE flyway_schema_history
SET version = '201',
    script = 'V00000201__add_statistics_chart_nodes.sql'
WHERE version IN ('100', '00000100')
  AND script = 'V0000100__add_statistics_chart_nodes.sql';

COMMIT;
```

These statements are idempotent no-ops when the bad rows were never applied.
